_doc: Trap, lock-cue and route-cue models of the POI dungeon mechanics (ADR-0018, ADR-0022). PoiBuilder places them from authored traps and door locks (not as scattered clutter: no 'clutter' tag, no rooms); they are defs so validate checks the models exist and so the procedural fallbacks (before `make assets`) have the right size. Models: tools/assetgen/blender/generators/props_traps.py (traps, locks) and props_cues.py (route cues). size = [width x, height y, depth z] in metres (Godot axes, front +Z). Lock models are mounted on a door leaf: origin on the leaf face at its latch edge, at mount height (parts hang below it).

defs.name: Bear Trap
defs.description: Long-spring trap set open, half under plaster lumps, newspaper and splinters; the chain trails to its ring.

defs.name: Sprung Bear Trap
defs.description: The same trap after it fired: jaws shut and standing, springs relaxed, debris scattered.

defs.name: Shotgun Trap
defs.description: Sawn-off side-by-side lashed to a green kitchen chair, barrels over the seat front; a cord from the trigger to a nail in the front stretcher.

defs.name: Loose Floorboards
defs.description: A metre square of loose, cupped and lifted fir boards with popped nails.

defs.name: Battery Door Alarm
defs.description: Siren box with grille, LED and key switch, a magnetic contact on its lead.

defs.name: Alarm Bell
defs.description: Brass hand bell hanging on a cord from a screw eye.

defs.name: Padlocked Hasp
defs.description: Hasp and staple across leaf and casing with a laminated padlock.

defs.name: Open Hasp
defs.description: The hasp left behind once the padlock is off, its strap swung open.

defs.name: Chained Door
defs.description: A chain between eye bolts in the leaf and the casing, padlocked.

defs.name: Deadbolt
defs.description: Keyed brass deadbolt cylinder and rose.

defs.name: Barrel Bolt
defs.description: Sliding barrel bolt on the inside face of a door.

defs.name: Torn Curtain
defs.description: Route cue (ADR-0022, RouteCues): a faded floral curtain on a zinc rod over a 1 m window, one panel still hanging, the other torn half off its rings and dragged out over the sill to hang down the outside wall. Origin: the window's centre on the wall's centre plane at the storey's floor; +Z = outside.

defs.name: Torn Curtains
defs.description: The same over a 2 m window: two panels left hanging either side, the middle one out over the sill.
